pālus

pālus, pālī m.

noun, second declension

a stake, a post, a prop

In this lexicon

  • stake

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Mil. 4.4.4: ut fīgam pālum in parietem (Lewis & Short); Cic. Verr. 2.5.11 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • hic docuit teneram pālīs adjungere vītem

    he taught men to tie the tender vine to stakesTib. 1.7.33

    In the entry for stake

  • vītēs clāviculīs adminicula, tamquam manibus apprehendunt
